text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
What is this...!? This heat surging from 
the depths of my body... !?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Hahaha! Are even the Three Goddesses 
giving me a push forward?"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'll show ya! I'll show you what 
it looks like when I stand at the very 
top!
